# TadaBoo

> Cute stationery, craft kits, squishies and curated gift bags. Thoughtfully packed, lovingly gifted. "Little things that make you go TADA!"

TadaBoo sells stationery and ready-to-gift bags in India. Shoppers pick a ready-made gift bag, or build their own from the shop. Orders can be placed on the website or on WhatsApp.

## What we sell

- Gift bags: 16 ready-made gift bags, priced from ₹169 to ₹1,132 (Indian rupees, INR). They cover Back to School, return gifts, themed bags for boys and girls, craft and colouring, and birthday hampers.
- Shop: 56 products (Pens & Highlighters; Pencils, Notebooks & Notes; Sharpeners & Erasers; Make & Create; Gift Sets & Squishy Fun).
- Minimum order: every order needs items (gift bags included) worth at least ₹299, before delivery.
- Colours, characters or designs may vary with availability. The product type and value always stay the same.
- Every order comes with a thank-you card and a TadaBoo bookmark.

## Delivery and payment

- We deliver anywhere in India, in 7–10 days from your order.
- Orders with items worth ₹999 or more ship free. Smaller orders pay ₹99, or ₹149 to the North East (Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura).
- Payment is online through Razorpay: UPI, debit or credit card, netbanking or a wallet, for the order total including delivery. Orders placed on WhatsApp get a Razorpay payment link.
- Cancelling: a website order can be cancelled in “My orders” within 2 hours of ordering, before the shop confirms it; after that, on WhatsApp any time before dispatch. Either way the full amount, including delivery, is refunded through Razorpay to the original payment method, in 5–7 working days. Dispatched orders can't be cancelled.
